targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, battery_pct AS "Battery %" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND battery_pct IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, range_km AS "Range (raw)" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND range_km IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, temp_inside AS "Cabin", temp_outside AS "Outside", battery_temp AS "Battery" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, voltage_12v AS "12V" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND voltage_12v IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN online THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN locked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, odometer AS value FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND odometer IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN ok THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM collector_heartbeats WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

SELECT
  to_timestamp(start_date / 1000.0) AS started,
  to_char(timezone('Europe/Moscow', to_timestamp(start_date / 1000.0)), 'HH24:MI')
    || ' - ' ||
  to_char(timezone('Europe/Moscow', to_timestamp(end_date / 1000.0)), 'HH24:MI') AS title,
  duration, distance, battery_consumption, odo_first, odo_last
FROM trips
ORDER BY segment_start_time DESC
LIMIT 20
SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN ignition THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN parked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN charging_gun THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, signal_level AS "value" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND signal_level IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, climate_target AS "value" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND climate_target IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, climate_fan AS "value" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND climate_fan IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts,
  online, online_state,
  battery_pct, range_km, charging_gun, battery_temp, voltage_12v,
  climate_target, climate_fan, temp_inside, temp_outside, coolant_temp,
  locked, ignition, parked, odometer, signal_level,
  raw->'sensors'->>'doorFLStatus' AS door_fl,
  raw->'sensors'->>'doorFRStatus' AS door_fr,
  raw->'sensors'->>'doorRLStatus' AS door_rl,
  raw->'sensors'->>'doorRRStatus' AS door_rr,
  raw->'sensors'->>'trunkStatus' AS trunk,
  raw->'sensors'->>'headLightsStatus' AS headlights,
  raw->'sensors'->>'firmwareVersion' AS firmware,
  raw->'sensors'->>'settingsVersion' AS settings,
  raw->'sensors'->>'fuelPercentage' AS fuel_pct,
  raw->'sensors'->>'remainsFuelMileage' AS fuel_range,
  raw->'status'->'warnings' AS warnings
FROM telemetry
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT b->>'title' AS title,
       b->>'status' AS status,
       b->>'enabled' AS enabled
FROM telemetry t,
     jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(t.raw->'status'->'buttons', '[]'::jsonb)) AS b
WHERE t.ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM telemetry)

SELECT ts AS time,
  CASE WHEN online THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Online",
  CASE WHEN locked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Замок",
  CASE WHEN ignition THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Зажигание",
  CASE WHEN parked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Паркинг",
  CASE WHEN charging_gun THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Пистолет"
FROM telemetry
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN charging_gun THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Gun" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time,
  coolant_temp AS "ОЖ",
  climate_target AS "Цель климата"
FROM telemetry
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, climate_fan AS "Fan" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND climate_fan IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'doorFLStatus' IN ('true','1','t') THEN 1 WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'doorFLStatus' IN ('false','0','f') THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS "value" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'doorFRStatus' IN ('true','1','t') THEN 1 WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'doorFRStatus' IN ('false','0','f') THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS "value" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'doorRLStatus' IN ('true','1','t') THEN 1 WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'doorRLStatus' IN ('false','0','f') THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS "value" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'doorRRStatus' IN ('true','1','t') THEN 1 WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'doorRRStatus' IN ('false','0','f') THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS "value" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'trunkStatus' IN ('true','1','t') THEN 1 WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'trunkStatus' IN ('false','0','f') THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS "value" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'headLightsStatus' IN ('true','1','t') THEN 1 WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'headLightsStatus' IN ('false','0','f') THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS "value" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'doorFLStatus' IN ('true','1','t') THEN 1 WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'doorFLStatus' IN ('false','0','f') THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS "FL", CASE WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'doorFRStatus' IN ('true','1','t') THEN 1 WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'doorFRStatus' IN ('false','0','f') THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS "FR", CASE WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'doorRLStatus' IN ('true','1','t') THEN 1 WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'doorRLStatus' IN ('false','0','f') THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS "RL", CASE WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'doorRRStatus' IN ('true','1','t') THEN 1 WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'doorRRStatus' IN ('false','0','f') THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS "RR", CASE WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'trunkStatus' IN ('true','1','t') THEN 1 WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'trunkStatus' IN ('false','0','f') THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS "Багажник", CASE WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'headLightsStatus' IN ('true','1','t') THEN 1 WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'headLightsStatus' IN ('false','0','f') THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS "Фары", CASE WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'isCentralLockingOn' IN ('true','1','t') THEN 1 WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'isCentralLockingOn' IN ('false','0','f') THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS "Замок" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, odometer AS "Odo" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND odometer IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time,
  CASE WHEN ignition THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Зажигание",
  CASE WHEN parked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Паркинг",
  signal_level AS "Сигнал"
FROM telemetry
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'fuelPercentage' ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN (raw->'sensors'->>'fuelPercentage')::double precision ELSE NULL END AS "Fuel %", CASE WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'remainsFuelMileage' ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN (raw->'sensors'->>'remainsFuelMileage')::double precision ELSE NULL END AS "Fuel range", CASE WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'firmwareVersion' ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN (raw->'sensors'->>'firmwareVersion')::double precision ELSE NULL END AS "Firmware", CASE WHEN raw->'sensors'->>'settingsVersion' ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN (raw->'sensors'->>'settingsVersion')::double precision ELSE NULL END AS "Settings" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Топливо / прошивка / settings (как пришло; у EV часто шум)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts,
  raw->'sensors'->>'firmwareVersion' AS firmware,
  raw->'sensors'->>'settingsVersion' AS settings,
  raw->'sensors'->>'fuelPercentage' AS fuel_pct,
  raw->'sensors'->>'remainsFuelMileage' AS fuel_range,
  raw->'sensors'->>'isOnline' AS sensors_is_online
FROM telemetry
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT
  to_char(timezone('Europe/Moscow', to_timestamp(start_date / 1000.0)), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS started_msk,
  to_char(timezone('Europe/Moscow', to_timestamp(start_date / 1000.0)), 'HH24:MI')
    || ' - ' ||
  to_char(timezone('Europe/Moscow', to_timestamp(end_date / 1000.0)), 'HH24:MI') AS title_msk,
  duration,
  distance,
  battery_consumption,
  battery_first,
  battery_last,
  odo_first,
  odo_last,
  travel_id
FROM trips
ORDER BY start_date DESC NULLS LAST, segment_start_time DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT to_timestamp(start_date / 1000.0) AS time,
  distance AS "Distance",
  battery_consumption AS "Battery Δ",
  (battery_first - battery_last) AS "Battery first-last"
FROM trips
WHERE start_date IS NOT NULL
  AND to_timestamp(start_date / 1000.0) BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz
ORDER BY start_date
